set.body:
SPI for generic N-D neighborhood execution used by image4s-ops.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] ravel-stencil module (or package) with NeighborhoodExecutor SPI
- [ ] source/dest views, leading spatial axes, offset table, border mapping, output region
- [ ] border index sequence tests: ReflectWith/WithoutEdge, Wrap, Replicate, Constant
- [ ] works for rank >= 1 leading spatial axes
- [ ] no image semantics (roles, mm, palettes)
set.title: ravel-stencil NeighborhoodExecutor SPI
